statement: Hand-designed synthetic LIF sidecar for the usefulness experiment. It is NOT a trained model and carries no learned capability. Its structure exists only so expected spikes are derivable from the weights.
format: Distill sidecar JSON (spikenaut-sidecar-json/v1), source spikenaut_julia, no output_weights key
weights: neuron n has weight 2.0 on input channel floor(n / 2) and 0.0 on every other channel; every row sums to 2.0, the neuromod 0.6 L1 weight budget, so renormalization leaves it unchanged
